connection.title: Connection
onboarding.title: Connect your VPS
onboarding.help: First install the control plane on your VPS, then link this app. The app generates the keys and token; you only copy one command and paste the code printed by the installer.
onboarding.generated: Command generated. Run it on the VPS as root.
onboarding.pending_help: Run the command on the VPS. When it finishes, the installer prints a pairing block: paste the whole block below.
onboarding.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
onboarding.reset_confirm: Discard the current command and start over?
onboarding.reset_done: Command discarded. Enter your VPS IP.
onboarding.paste_placeholder: Paste the installer block here (it contains the ut1.… code)
onboarding.linked: VPS linked. You can open ports now.
connection.pair_help: Run umbrel-tunnel pair on the VPS (or copy the code printed by the installer) and paste it here. The code contains the API and token; the app generates its own WireGuard key.
connection.unpair_confirm: Unpair and close the ports managed by this app?
connection.unpaired: Unpaired. The WireGuard configuration has been removed.
connection.pair_manual: Pairing saved. Now configure WireGuard in the Connection tab.
connection.wg_help: Active configuration in this container. The private key is never shown.
connection.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
connection.rotate_confirm: Rotate the WireGuard key? The VPS will receive the new public key.
connection.rotated: Key rotated and registered on the VPS.
connection.manual_help: If the code does not include an endpoint or public key, configure the tunnel here. The private key stays in this container.
connection.registered: Public key registered on the VPS.
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.api_help: Usually filled in when pairing. The token is stored in /data/config.json with mode 600.
advanced.manual_help: Add a host and port that were not detected automatically. Manual services are marked as sensitive.
advanced.note_api: The VPS API only listens on 10.0.0.1:8080 inside the tunnel.
advanced.note_ssh: Port 22 on the VPS is reserved for its SSH; use another public port for Umbrel SSH (e.g. 2222).
advanced.note_tcp: The local proxy only supports TCP. UDP ports can be opened from the VPS CLI.
advanced.note_token: If you change the token on the VPS, pair again.
login.title: Umbrel Tunnel
login.subtitle: Enter the app password to continue.
login.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
login.csrf: The session expired. Reload the page.
login.hint: Umbrel shows this password in the app details (APP_PASSWORD).
system.ssh.description: SSH access to the host. Do not use VPS port 22: pick another public port.
system.umbrel-dashboard.description: Main Umbrel interface. Exposing it grants access to the admin panel.
system.umbrel-dashboard-https.descriptio: Umbrel interface over HTTPS. Exposing it grants access to the admin panel.
error.invalid_vps_ip: The VPS IP is not valid.
error.vps_ip_not_public: The VPS IP must be public (IPv4).
error.already_paired: The app is already paired. Unpair first.
error.invalid_bootstrap: The tunnel details are not valid.
error.pair_bootstrap_mismatch: The code does not match the command generated by this app ({field}). Generate a new command or check the VPS.
error.csrf: Invalid CSRF token. Reload the page.
error.service_not_found: Service not found; refresh the list.
error.unsupported_protocol: This service uses UDP and cannot be opened from the app. Use the VPS CLI.
error.invalid_public_port: The public port must be between 1 and 65535.
error.reserved_public_port: Port 22 is the VPS SSH port; choose another one (for example 2222).
error.vps_close_failed: Could not close the port on the VPS.
error.pair_prefix: The code must start with ut1.
error.pair_api: The code contains an invalid API URL.
error.pair_token: The code does not contain a token.
error.pair_overlap: Subnet {subnet} overlaps Umbrel's network ({network}). Change --subnet on the VPS.
error.pair_address: The tunnel IP is invalid for that subnet.
error.pair_endpoint: The endpoint must use the host:port format.
error.pair_pubkey: The server public key is invalid.
error.pair_manual_missing: The server endpoint and public key are missing.
error.peer_register_failed: Could not register the public key on the VPS. It will be retried on the next sync.
error.not_paired: The app is not paired with a VPS.
error.invalid_interval_range: The interval must be between 10 and 3600 seconds.
error.vps: The VPS API returned an error.
error.wg_rotate_failed: Could not rotate the key; the previous one was restored.
pair.manual_required: Pairing saved. Now configure WireGuard in the Connection tab.
pair.manual_instructions: Add this public key to the VPS: umbrel-tunnel peer add --name umbrel --ip {client_ip} --pubkey {public_key}
